SELECT [e].[VendorId], [t].[CompanyName] AS [VendorName], COALESCE(SUM([e].[TotalAmount]), 0.0) AS [Spend], COUNT(*) AS [Expenses], COUNT(DISTINCT (CASE
    WHEN [e].[ContractId] IS NOT NULL THEN [e].[ContractId]
END)) AS [Contracts]
